title: Sociotechnical Harms of Algorithmic Systems: Scoping a Taxonomy for Harm Reduction
findings: The paper's taxonomy of sociotechnical harms includes representational harms that can affect religious groups. Specific examples cited from existing research include demeaning harms, such as hateful natural language predictions targeting Muslim people, and erasing harms, characterized by the marginalization of non-Western and underrepresented religious identities in algorithmic systems.
